plan.title: bug(session,worktree): session start re-deposits retired .deft/core into linked worktrees of runtime-pinned projects

narratives.Description: OVPR fix plan group G-A (story id ovpr-g-worktree-core), unit P2-U12, issue #6562, decision D-010; partly addresses #6465 ('Two more regressions', item 1). `reconstituteLinkedWorktreeDeposit` copies a full retired `.deft/core` into linked worktrees of consumer projects on every mutating `session:start` / `session:ready`, with no runtime-pin check (436 untracked files in deftai/evolution). Remove the path: session start and session ready stop calling it, swarm worktree prep without a runtime pin fails closed with the Rule 3 project-install message, the reconstitution functions are deleted from gitignore.ts, and doctor's `manifest-agreement` loses its reconstitution branch. One PR.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

In a runtime-pinned (OVPR) consumer project, every mutating `session:start` and `session:ready` in a linked worktree copies a full `.deft/core` into that worktree. `.deft/core` is the retired vendored layout. The session output does not mention it.

## Evidence

Consumer report in #6465 (comment "Two more regressions", item 1): deftai/evolution worktree after `directive upgrade --yes` to 0.129.11. Each mutating `session:start` wrote 436 untracked files under `.deft/core`, again after deletion.

Cause (code reading, origin/master `d645489e6`):
- `reconstituteLinkedWorktreeDeposit` (`packages/core/src/init-deposit/gitignore.ts:965`, from #4443 / #5390, before OVPR) is called from `session/session-start.ts:2315` and `session/session-ready.ts:273` with no runtime-pin check.
- It copies from a resolvable `@deftai/directive-content` package, else from the primary checkout's `.deft/core`. Evolution had both: the primary was still on the old layout, and the app depends on `@deftai/directive@0.126.2`.
- `swarm/worktree-pm-install.ts:381-395` already runs the PM install when pinned and reconstitutes only when there is no pin.

## Expected

No code path writes `.deft/core` in a consumer project. A worktree without the runtime gets the project-install message (AC9.12), not a copy of retired content.

## Ownership

OVPR / installer (deposit, pin-absent behaviour). Plan unit P2-U12. Decision D-010 (polfer, 2026-11-17).

## Refs

#6465, #4443, #5390, #6001 (same `manifest-agreement` check in doctor).
narratives.UserStory: As a developer working in a linked worktree of a runtime-pinned project, I want session start to write nothing under `.deft/core`, so that my worktree has no hundreds of untracked retired files and a worktree with no runtime gets the project-install message instead.

narratives.UnitSpec: ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/units/P2-U12-stop-worktree-deft-core-reconstitution.md (read in full). groups.md G-A: one PR (the spec's PR 1 and PR 2 together). Decision D-010.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts, session-ready.ts, session-start-occupancy-barrier-worker.ts: remove the reconstitution step, its option seam and `linkedDepositDeny`. Session start writes nothing under `.deft/core`.
2. packages/core/src/swarm/worktree-pm-install.ts: keep the pinned branch (PM install). Replace the not-pinned branch with a fail-closed result `code: "pin-missing"` whose message is the existing Rule 3 project-install constant from install-health (no new wording; the message table is G-G).
3. packages/core/src/init-deposit/gitignore.ts: delete `reconstituteLinkedWorktreeDeposit`, `resolveWorktreePayloadSource`, `copyWorktreePayloadSync`, `ensureWorktreeVersionManifest`, `WORKTREE_RECONSTITUTE_FETCHED_BY` and their types. Keep `looksLikePayload` / `resolvePayloadSourceVersion` only if something else still uses them.
4. packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts: remove the `eligibleReconstitute` branch from `manifest-agreement`, consistent with what P2-U2 (#6001) settled for leftover `.deft-version`.
5. Tests: delete or rewrite reconstitution tests (gitignore.test.ts, session-start.test.ts, session-ready.test.ts, worktree-pm-install.test.ts, resolution/cold-clone-reconstitution.test.ts, doctor/checks.test.ts) and fix incidental references (greenfield-pin-clone.harness.test.ts, hook-runtime-travel.test.ts, refresh.test.ts, resolution/plan.test.ts, dest-contention-it-timeout tests, runtime cli-router/router.test.ts). New behaviour tests: linked worktree of a pinned project with a primary `.deft/core` and a resolvable `@deftai/directive-content` -> mutating session:start writes nothing under `.deft/core`; swarm worktree prep with no pin -> `pin-missing`, project-install text, no files written. No grep-only guard tests (groups.md).
6. Changelog fragment changelog.d/6562-no-worktree-deft-core.md.
narratives.Constraint:
- Don't delete or clean up an existing `.deft/core` in a worktree or primary checkout (removal belongs to `directive upgrade`).
- Don't add any new deposit, copy or symlink of runtime content outside `node_modules`.
- Don't change the framework-source (dogfood) behaviour.
- Don't change the Rule 3 wording; reuse the existing install-health constant.
- No guard-only 'prevent it coming back' tests; prove the behaviour with real tests.
- OVPR change gate: read ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/OVPR-CHANGE-GATE.md. Do not edit docs/installer-refactor-ovpr/ and do not ship behaviour that departs from the written OVPR requirements or architecture; stop that part and hand back a change proposal.
- Changelog: add the changelog.d fragment named in file_scope; never edit CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Dependencies: Depends on: P2-U2 (#6001 / github.issue.6082665123, same `manifest-agreement` code in doctor/checks.ts). Blocks: none. Decision D-010.
narratives.PlanningOrder: design-critique: not warranted, because the OVPR fix plan and its unit specs already decide the design (polfer decisions D-001, D-008, D-037)
narratives.Traces: Closes #6562. Partly addresses #6465 (item 1 of 'Two more regressions'). Refs #4443, #5390, #6001.

items.title: No code path in packages/ writes `.deft/core` in a consumer project: the linked-worktree reconstitution functions are deleted and nothing calls a `.deft/core` copy routine.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the changed tree, when packages/core/src/init-deposit/gitignore.ts and its former callers are read, then `reconstituteLinkedWorktreeDeposit`, `resolveWorktreePayloadSource`, `copyWorktreePayloadSync` and `ensureWorktreeVersionManifest` no longer exist and session start, session ready, the occupancy barrier worker and swarm worktree prep call no `.deft/core` copy routine.

items.title: `session:start` and `session:ready` in a linked worktree leave `git status` unchanged with respect to `.deft/core`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a linked worktree of a runtime-pinned project whose primary checkout still has `.deft/core` and where `@deftai/directive-content` is resolvable, when a mutating `session:start` or `session:ready` runs in the worktree, then no file is written under `.deft/core` in that worktree.

items.title: Swarm worktree prep without a runtime pin fails closed with `pin-missing` and the Rule 3 project-install message, and writes no files.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a linked worktree with no runtime pin, when swarm worktree prep runs, then it returns `code: "pin-missing"` with the existing Rule 3 project-install text and writes no files.

items.title: Doctor's `manifest-agreement` check has no reconstitution branch.

narrative.Acceptance: Given packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts, when the `manifest-agreement` check runs in a linked worktree with no `.deft/core`, then it reports from the runtime pin only and never suggests or evaluates reconstituting `.deft/core`.
